title: Junior Structural Drafter
abstract: Join a supportive team and develop your skills in estimating and design while gaining valuable hands-on experience in the steel industry.
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
content_text:
An established Southern Highlands business is looking for a Junior Structural Drafter to join its team in Braemar.
 This is an entry-level opportunity for someone who is interested in structural design, engineering, and technical detail. You’ll work alongside an experienced Design Manager and supportive team, learning how to prepare estimates and drawings for steel framing systems.
 The role focuses on structural drafting and detailing. You’ll learn to read architectural plans, engineering plans and develop steel floor and roof framing layouts, including bearers, joists, piers, rafters and purlins. Training will be provided in the company’s AutoCAD-based software and specialised steel framing tools.
 What you’ll do
 - Assist with estimates, structural drawings and revised project quotes.
 - Review architectural, engineering plans and project requirements.
 - Learn to prepare steel floor and roof framing layouts.
 - Use Excel and company systems to maintain accurate project information.
 - Communicate with customers and the sales team about project requirements.
 - Support the design team with day-to-day tasks.
 What you’ll bring
 - An interest in structural drafting, construction or how buildings fit together.
 - Good computer skills and a willingness to learn new software.
 - Confidence working with numbers and attention to detail.
 - Good organisation, communication and problem-solving skills.
 - A positive attitude and willingness to learn from feedback.
 No previous drafting or estimating experience is required. Applications are welcome from school leavers, graduates and people looking to move into a new field.
 What’s on offer
 - Full-time hours, Monday to Friday.
 - An office-based role in Braemar, Southern Highlands.
 - On-the-job training and support from an experienced team.
 - The opportunity to develop long-term skills in structural drafting and estimating.
 How to apply
 If you’re enthusiastic, technically minded and ready to learn, we’d love to hear from you.
